Class StandardScoringStrategy

java.lang.Object
aslframework.game.scoring.StandardScoringStrategy
All Implemented Interfaces:
ScoringStrategy
public class StandardScoringStrategy extends Object implements ScoringStrategy
Flat scoring strategy: score = floor(accuracy × 100) × tier.

Used by

invalid reference 
aslframework.game.session.BattleSession
. There is no streak bonus — every attempt is scored independently.
